voice_policy: plain modern English; from Satsang’s own summary; the VBT translation is never quoted

lines.text: Let attention rest on the whole body at once. Not one part: the whole field of sensation.
Now take the body, and the world around it, as made of awareness.
Let this be felt, rather than thought.
When the mind narrows back to me and mine, return to the wider field, and rest there.
